values: 战斗开始时获得护盾以及逐渐损失的额外生命上限，并且会在自身生命恢复至上限后进入“神临”状态。主动释放时对前方3格扇形范围造成真实伤害并恢复自身生命值。

When a battle starts, Baelran gains a shield and bonus max HP that gradually decreases over time. Baelran enters Celestial Form when he is restored to his max HP. When Baelran casts this skill, he deals true damage to enemies within a 3-tile arc in front of him and restores HP.

战斗开始时巴赫朗获得80% + 5%初始生命值的护盾以及300% HP额外生命上限且当前生命值不变，这部分额外生命上限每秒损失2%。战斗中巴赫朗生命恢复至上限后展开双翼，对周围2格敌人造成10% HP伤害并进入“神临”状态：不再损失本技能获得的额外生命上限，并且普通攻击会对面前1格扇形区域内的所有敌军造成伤害。逐渐获得额外生命上限以及进入“神临”状态的动作期间处于霸体状态。
主动释放时，向圣剑注入神力，对前方3格扇形范围内所有敌人造成280% + 40% ATK真实伤害，随后自身恢复实际伤害量40%的生命值。

Passive. When a battle starts, Baelran gains a shield equal to 80% + 5% of his initial HP and receives 300% HP bonus max HP. This bonus max HP does not raise Baelran's current HP and decreases by 2% every second.
When Baelran is restored to his max HP, he spreads his wings, deals 10% HP damage to enemies within 2 tiles, and enters Celestial Form. While in Celestial Form, the bonus max HP no longer decreases, and his normal attacks strike all enemies within a 1-tile arc in front of him. Baelran is unaffected while receiving bonus max HP and while transitioning into Celestial Form.
Active. Baelran channels divine power into his blade, dealing 280% + 40% ATK true damage to all enemies within a 3-tile arc in front of him. He then restores HP equal to 40% of the damage dealt by the active strike.
主动释放时造成的伤害提高至300% + 40% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the active strike to 300% + 40% ATK.
主动释放时造成的伤害提高至320% + 40% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the active strike to 320% + 40% ATK.
主动释放时造成的伤害提高至340% + 40% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the active strike to 340% + 40% ATK.
主动释放时造成的伤害提高至360% + 40% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by the active strike to 360% + 40% ATK.
被动地，巴赫朗在战斗中持续恢复生命值。“神临”状态下攻击会对敌人造成额外真实伤害。
Passive. Baelran gradually restores HP during battle. In Celestial Form, his attacks deal extra true damage with each hit.
被动地，巴赫朗每秒恢复2% HP生命值；进入“神临”状态后，圣剑永久附着“圣光”，在每次命中敌人时额外附带1.5% + 0.25% HP真实伤害。
Passive. Baelran restores 2% HP HP every second. While in Celestial Form, his blade is permanently imbued with Divine Light, dealing an extra 1.5% + 0.25% HP true damage with each hit.
“圣光”额外附带伤害提高至1.8% + 0.25% HP。
Increases the extra damage granted by Divine Light to 1.8% + 0.25% HP.
“圣光”额外附带伤害提高至2.1% + 0.25% HP。
Increases the extra damage granted by Divine Light to 2.1% + 0.25% HP.
“圣光”额外附带伤害提高至2.5% + 0.25% HP。
Increases the extra damage granted by Divine Light to 2.5% + 0.25% HP.
挑飞敌人并击倒面前矩形范围内的所有敌人。
Baelran knocks an enemy into the air, then knocks down all enemies in a rectangular area in front of him.
使用圣剑挑飞面前目标造成180% + 20% ATK伤害，随后向下劈砍，对前方3格矩形范围内的敌人造成300% + 40% ATK伤害并使其倒地2秒。

Baelran knocks his target into the air with an upward slash, dealing 180% + 20% ATK damage. He then slams his sword down, dealing 300% + 40% ATK damage to enemies within a 3-tile rectangular area in front of him, knocking them down for 2s.
Increase the slam damage to 320% + 40% ATK.
Increase the slam damage to 340% + 40% ATK.
Increase the slam damage to 360% + 40% ATK.
提高自身急速，每次进入“神临”状态后进一步提高。
Baelran increases his Haste, and further increases it when he enters Celestial Form or enhanced Celestial Form.
战斗中，自身的急速提升9点，每次进入“神临”状态后额外提升3点。
Baelran increases his Haste by 9 during battle, and further increases it by 3 whenever he enters Celestial Form or enhanced Celestial Form.
战斗中，自身的急速提升12点，每次进入“神临”状态后额外提升4点。
Baelran increases his Haste by 12 during battle, and further increases it by 4 whenever he enters Celestial Form or enhanced Celestial Form.
战斗中，自身的急速提升15点，每次进入“神临”状态后额外提升5点。
Baelran increases his Haste by 15 during battle, and further increases it by 5 whenever he enters Celestial Form or enhanced Celestial Form.
首次进入“神临”状态后，恢复“神圣御空”技能中损失的额外生命上限，并且在生命恢复至上限后进入更强大的“神临”状态，永久霸体并且终极技能会额外召唤圣光造成真实伤害。

When Baelran enters Celestial Form, he fully regains the bonus max HP granted by Celestial Rise. If he is restored to max HP again, he enters an enhanced Celestial Form, becoming unaffected permanently and empowering his Ultimate to call down Divine Light strikes that deal true damage.
首次进入“神临”状态后，恢复“神圣御空”技能中损失的额外生命上限，并且当巴赫朗生命再次恢复至上限后进入更强大的“神临”状态，对周围2格敌人造成10% HP真实伤害并永久处于霸体状态，主动释放“神圣御空”后，会在技能范围内每个地图格召唤“圣光”，造成6% HP真实伤害，每次释放时“圣光”命中相同目标的后续伤害降低10%。

When Baelran enters Celestial Form, he fully regains the bonus max HP granted by Celestial Rise. If he is restored to max HP again, he enters an enhanced Celestial Form, dealing 10% HP true damage to enemies within 2 tiles and becoming unaffected permanently.
When casting Celestial Rise, Baelran calls down Divine Light strikes on every tile within the affected area, dealing 6% HP true damage per strike. If an enemy is hit multiple times, the damage they take from each successive strike is reduced by 10%.
召唤“圣光”造成的伤害提高至8% HP。
Increases the damage dealt by each Divine Light strike to 8% HP.
召唤“圣光”造成的伤害提高至10% HP。
Increases the damage dealt by each Divine Light strike to 10% HP.
每次进入“神临”状态时，移除自身所有可驱散的负面状态并且永久提高10%攻击力，第二次进入“神临”状态时还会在自身周围2格范围内召唤“圣光”造成10% HP真实伤害。

When Baelran enters Celestial Form, he dispels all debuffs on himself and permanently increases his ATK by 10%. Upon entering enhanced Celestial Form, Baelran calls down Divine Light strikes on every tile within 2 tiles of him, dealing 10% HP true damage per strike to enemies hit.
圣光附带的伤害会削减非首领敌人一定比例的生命上限，会使首领敌人额外失去生命。
The extra damage caused by the Divine Light reduces the max HP of non-boss enemies by a set percentage, or causes extra HP loss to bosses.
“圣光”对非首领敌人造成伤害时会削减目标相当于伤害量70%的生命上限，累计削减部分不超过目标40%最大生命值以及巴赫朗800%攻击力；对首领敌人造成伤害则使其流失0.7% HP的生命值。

The extra damage caused by the Divine Light can also reduce the max HP of non-boss enemies by 70% of the damage dealt. This max HP reduction cannot exceed 40% of the target's max HP or 800% of Baelran's ATK, whichever is lower. When fighting against boss enemies, this skill does not reduce max HP; instead, it causes them to lose 0.7% HP HP.
